messages:
Aisha (CSM): Heads up — Universal Health QBR next Tue. Finance flagged a big embeddings spike last month, potential renewal risk. Can we align on a spend forecast + mitigation plan?
Marco (FinOps): saw that. spike = 3.2M embed units in Feb -> big cost jump. quick forecast below.
Marco (FinOps): ```
Current run-rate: $12k/mo
Projected w/o changes: $18k/mo
Top-3 endpoints = 78% of embed usage
Estimated simple fixes -> ~20% cost reduction (batching + cache)
```
Priya (Enablement): I can run a focused embed-ops workshop Wed 11am PT — will cover batching, prefix caching, and SDK patterns to reduce calls.
Aisha (CSM): perfect. can you produce a 1-page playbook we can hand to the customer in the QBR?
Priya (Enablement): yep — workshop + one-pager. will attach before EOD Mon.
Marco (FinOps): recommend we also set a soft budget alert plus a hard threshold throttle. ops-bot can create the alert. @ops-bot create alert universal-health spend threshold $15k/mo
ops-bot: created alert id alo-9832 — https://redwood.ops/alerts/alo-9832 :white_check_mark:
Aisha (CSM): adding to QBR deck: slide with forecast, remediation plan, and timeline. action owners: Priya (workshop & playbook), Marco (forecast + alerts), Aisha (QBR deck + renewal notes).
Marco (FinOps): I'll draft the forecast table and quotas, will share CSV and quick-run numbers by Tue EOD.
Priya (Enablement): suggested customer checklist: 1) enable batching where possible; 2) prefix/KV cache for repeated contexts; 3) reduce embed retention TTL; 4) instrument token-level cost telemetry in SDK.
Aisha (CSM): clear. TL;DR next steps: Priya workshop Wed 11am PT, Marco alert + forecast by Tue EOD, Aisha update QBR slides by Wed noon.
Marco (FinOps): noted. tagging Finance for potential credit/offset approval if the customer needs runway.
Finance (bot): request queued for review (ref# 2026-03-21-UH).
Aisha (CSM): thanks team. If anyone hits blockers (API changes, infra limits, or customer schedules) please post here. :memo: :eyes:
Priya (Enablement): one question — can we get customer usage logs exported for the workshop? need top-queries by endpoint.
Marco (FinOps): will request logs export from eng-analytics, ETA Tue morning.
Aisha (CSM): I'll ping the customer for a 30-min pre-workshop sync to confirm priorities.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled — workshop Wed 11am PT (calendar invite sent).
__note: This thread is a concise customer-success ops sync about cost/QBR prep, token economics, spend alerts, and enablement coordination. All messages are in chronological order and formatted as a single Slack thread string.
